description: Backend undo / redo of the active library entry (SSOT I3).

commands.name: history.undo
commands.title: Undo
commands.description: Reverts the latest edit group of the active entry, or the latest group touching `domains` (e.g. feedback@output).

group.description: Optional: only the latest group with this X-Pianoid-Group id (e.g. one assistant turn)

commands.name: history.redo
commands.title: Redo
commands.description: Re-applies the latest undone group (same domain filter as history.undo).

group.description: Optional: only the latest group with this X-Pianoid-Group id (e.g. one assistant turn)

commands.name: history.get
commands.title: Undo / redo state
commands.description: {entry, can_undo, can_redo, undo, redo, undo_domains, redo_domains, undo_groups, redo_groups, depth}.
